name: AIRA AI 2026 — Payment & Commercial Billing Knowledge Graph (Reconciled & Synchronized)

nodes.name: PaymentGatewayService
nodes.description: Core payment gateway integration managing Razorpay and Cashfree webhook verification, checkout session creation, recurring mandate handling, calendar-month renewal calculation with anchor day preservation, reconciliation, invoice allocation, and credit note issuance.

nodes.name: CommercialBillingService
nodes.description: Commercial billing service managing billing customer profiles, tax profiles, credit grants (3,000 Plus / 7,500 Pro), credit reservations/settlement, standard chat quota enforcement, and tier restrictions.

nodes.name: TaxDeterminationService
nodes.description: Statutory Indian GST and zero-rated export calculation engine implementing IGST Act Sec 12(2), CGST Act Sec 31/34, 37 Indian jurisdictions (UP 09 supplier), verified non-India export LUT determination (lutApproved), B2B/B2C Place of Supply, integer-paise math, and provisional SAC 998315 logic (PENDING_APPROVAL).

nodes.name: GstDocumentRenderer
nodes.description: Generates A4 printable, accessible HTML tax invoices and credit notes satisfying CGST Rule 46 and Rule 53(1A) with zero external fonts and sanitized CSS. Distinct from IT Act 2000 Section 65B electronic record certificate and CGST Rule 48(4) e-invoicing.

nodes.name: ProductionReadinessService
nodes.description: 14-gate commercial production readiness auditor enforcing fail-closed release gates (live credentials, webhooks, UP 09 GSTIN, SAC 998315 amendment, and CA sign-off).

nodes.name: BillingRoutes
nodes.description: Express router exposing protected and public endpoints for checkout, webhooks, customer tax profiles, invoices, credit notes, and readiness audit.

nodes.name: Migration 036: GST Invoice Compliance Snapshots & FY Sequences
nodes.description: Expand-only Knex migration creating billing_document_sequences table, extending billing_invoices with immutable snapshot columns, extending billing_credit_notes with CGST Rule 53(1A) tax split, and extending billing_customers with B2B GSTIN profile.

nodes.name: billing_document_sequences
nodes.description: Atomic FY-partitioned serial sequence table with composite primary key (document_scope, financial_year) and check constraint chk_billing_doc_seq_nonnegative.

nodes.name: billing_invoices
nodes.description: Stores issued tax invoices with immutable issuance_snapshot JSONB, discrete relational snapshot columns, supplier/customer state snapshots, SAC breakdown, and FY index.

nodes.name: billing_credit_notes
nodes.description: Stores issued credit notes satisfying CGST Rule 53(1A) with original invoice linkage, reason, and proportional CGST/SGST/UTGST/IGST reversal.

nodes.name: billing_customers
nodes.description: Customer entity linking principal_id with structured billing address and optional validated B2B customer_gstin.

nodes.name: subscriptions
nodes.description: Stores user subscriptions with gateway ID, status (active, cancelled, pending, refunded), current period dates, plan tier, fulfilled cycle, and metadata containing billingAnchorDay.

nodes.name: credit_grants
nodes.description: Entitlement grant ledger recording total and remaining credits per subscription cycle with grant isolation and expiry timestamps (3,000 for Plus, 7,500 for Pro).

nodes.name: credit_accounts
nodes.description: Customer credit account balances tracking available balance_credits and currently reserved_credits.

nodes.name: credit_reservations
nodes.description: Tracks active credit holds with 15-minute TTL, status (HELD, SETTLED, CANCELLED), and reservation tokens.

nodes.name: credit_transactions
nodes.description: Immutable ledger of all credit balance changes (grants, reservations, settlements, expiries, refunds).

nodes.name: subscription_cancellation_outbox
nodes.description: Outbox table managing asynchronous cancellation retries, CAS claims, and late payment reconciliation on cancelled subscriptions.

nodes.name: payment_gateway_events
nodes.description: Audit and deduplication table recording incoming raw gateway webhooks with unique event_id index preventing replay.

nodes.name: billing_audit_events
nodes.description: Immutable audit ledger recording all financial transitions, invoice issuances, reconciliation steps, and refunds.
